WITH RECURSIVE destination_regions AS ( SELECT d.id AS destination_id, region.id AS region_id, region.parent_id, region.region_name, region.code, SUBSTRING_INDEX(region.code, '-', 1) AS country_code FROM destinations d JOIN country_categories region ON region.id = d.region_id
UNION ALL
SELECT destination_regions.destination_id, parent.id AS region_id, parent.parent_id, parent.region_name, parent.code, destination_regions.country_code FROM destination_regions JOIN country_categories parent ON parent.id = destination_regions.parent_id ), destination_countries AS ( SELECT destination_id, region_id AS country_id, region_name AS country_name FROM destination_regions WHERE code = country_code AND ( parent_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM country_categories country_child WHERE country_child.parent_id = destination_regions.region_id AND country_child.code LIKE CONCAT(destination_regions.code, '-%') ) ) ) SELECT d.id AS destination_id, dt.name AS destination_name, d.type, dt.short_description, di.image_url AS thumbnail_url, cc.region_name, cc.id AS region_id, pcc.region_name AS parent_region_name, dc.country_id, dc.country_name FROM destinations d JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN destination_images di ON di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON cc.parent_id = pcc.id LEFT JOIN destination_countries dc ON dc.destination_id = d.id WHERE d.is_public = 1 AND ( dt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dt.short_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dt.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cc.region_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pcc.region_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND dc.country_id = #{countryId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM country_categories country WHERE country.id = dc.country_id AND country.code = 'KR')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM country_categories country WHERE country.id = dc.country_id AND country.code != 'KR')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_regions ancestor WHERE ancestor.destination_id = d.id AND ancestor.region_id = #{regionId} )
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
